```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cjoint)

d_all <- read.csv('d_all.csv', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
d_all$role <- relevel(d_all$role, ref = 'Monitor health status and send alerts')
d_all$FDA <- relevel(d_all$FDA, ref = 'not subject to')
d_all$mention_human <- relevel(d_all$mention_human, ref = 'no mention similar to human')
d_all$inc <- relevel(d_all$inc, ref = 'Less than 25k')

d_us <- filter(d_all, country == 'US') %>% droplevels()
d_cn <- filter(d_all, country == 'CN') %>% droplevels()
```

```{r}
# Use
amce(likely_use ~ area+severe_level+FDA+role+mention_human+price+model_type+lead_by+female+agecat+edu+inc+hispanic+white+black+native+asian+hawaiian,
                                  data = d_us) %>% summary()
amce(likely_use ~ area+severe_level+FDA+role+mention_human+price+model_type+lead_by+female+agecat+edu,
                                  data = d_cn) %>% summary()
amce(likely_use ~ area+severe_level+FDA+role+mention_human+price+model_type+lead_by+female+agecat+edu+country,
                                  data = d_all) %>% summary()
amce(likely_use ~ area+severe_level+FDA+role+mention_human+price+model_type+lead_by+female+agecat+edu+country+role:country,
                                  data = d_all) %>% summary()
```
